consumer: The frontend map renderer drawing each nearby tile, asking 'what terrain/furniture should the GUI display here for this player?' (visibility/memory-filtered), not 'what is the raw ground-truth terrain?'
scope: Per-tile display view bounded by the player's current sight/light and remembered map (LOS + map-memory + fog), not the full raw map
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles uses ctx.m.ter(p)/ctx.m.furn(p), which return raw map ground-truth ids with no visibility, lighting, or map-memory filtering applied
divergence: A tile behind an unexplored wall (never seen): the GUI map view shows blank/unknown, but raw m.ter(p) reports the true t_wall/t_floor and m.furn(p) the real furniture, leaking unseen terrain the player has not discovered
